fieldValues.title: Retire 11 empty section/subsection husks (RFC-042 Change B, srs#710)
fieldValues.summary: Deleted 11 empty section/subsection records under rfc-decision-1e7c0c8e: each had zero content and zero contains children, and each topic was already covered by an existing successor concept from an earlier batch. Two local precedes chains ran entirely through the batch and needed no splice.
fieldValues.body:
Claimed 2026-09-11T11:21Z from srs#710's gate:dispatched via srs#580's queue, responding directly to the coordinator's fresh dispatch (comment 5633670254). Ground re-measured current state on a freshly unshallowed worktree off origin/master (85b58f7, carries PR #755): 1 section (Key Invariants) and 31 subsections remained, matching the last dispatch's own count exactly (no drift).

Built a full relation map (all ~6000 corpus relations, inbound+outbound per remaining subsection) rather than inspecting records one at a time, to identify which of the 31 were pure empty husks before choosing a batch. Found 11 with fieldValues.content === "" and zero outgoing contains edges: Lifecycle (ext:lifecycle), Field semantics — content format, Views L2 navigation (ext:views-l2), Views (ext:views-l1), Field semantics, Repository (ext:repository), Views L2 (ext:views-l2), Protocol (ext:protocol), Type inheritance (ext:type-inheritance), Addressability (ext:addressability), Cross-field validation (ext:cross-field-validation). Checked each one's sole contains-parent directly via record get and confirmed every one is an existing com.semanticops.spec/concept record whose title names the exact same topic (Lifecycle, Field, View, Repository, Protocol, Type specialisation, Addressability, Validation) — the same empty-husk pattern PR #752/#755 established, so no successor was needed, just deletion after the manifest-citation and precedes-chain checks.

Per carried-context-7668a275 (precedes-splice requirement), traced both local precedes chains running through the candidate set before deleting anything: 812a7f7f -> 078b205b -> fee1b9fe -> 6a3ae7a9 (4 nodes) and b8fa7bbe -> 90db4d42 -> d95bae97 -> 31bc8a13 -> cd8fdb47 -> 38d8c953 -> 8c665338 (7 nodes). Queried the full corpus relation set (not just this subsection type) for any precedes edge into the chain heads (812a7f7f, b8fa7bbe) or out of the chain tails (6a3ae7a9, 8c665338) and found none — both chains are fully self-contained within the 11-record batch, with no live neighbour on either end. Deleted all 11 with record delete --cascade and confirmed via each call's own cascadedRelations report that only relations among the 11 (plus their now-severed contains-parent edges) were removed — no external dangling edge, so no splice was required this time. This differs from PR #755's finding, which is why it is worth recording explicitly: the pattern the prior carried_context describes (an external neighbour left dangling) simply did not arise here, because this batch happened to contain two complete self-contained chains rather than isolated nodes or a mid-chain span.

Per carried-context-c4e43a58, grepped every RFC's srs-integration manifest (all section:/subsection:/concept:/mechanism:/ext:/type: tokens extracted programmatically, not just a title-string grep) for a token matching any of the 11 titles' slugs — zero hits.

Per carried-context-4c6e0ddc, checked whether any of the 11 titles starts with the literal ext: prefix (the shadow-record fallback resolution rule) — none does; all 11 are "Name (ext:slug)" form, which the fallback rule does not match. No shadow-record risk for this batch.

Container membership (srs/containers/*.json) updated automatically by the CLI on cascade delete, matching PR #755's observation rather than PR #749's cross-Part case; part-container-membership.mjs --check: zero drift both before and after.

Both gates verified green by direct exit code on the pinned CLI (v0.1.0-build.376), unshallowed worktree: validate-all.mjs and check-release-drift.mjs (the latter caught the expected stale-render failure before publish-spec.mjs re-rendered, then passed clean). Heading-set diff vs origin/master: 595 -> 584, all 11 removed headings accounted for by already-existing successor concepts, zero content lost, zero new headings.

Running tally under rfc-decision-1e7c0c8e: #744 (7 sections) - #745 (6 subsections) - #747 (2 sections) - #749 (5 subsections) - #752 (9 subsections) - #755 (5 subsections) - this unit/PR #756 (11 subsections) = 45/75 retired. Remaining for srs#710: Key Invariants (no successor yet, blocked on an invariant-region.mjs redesign, carried-context-31ea3659) and 20 more subsection records, then the final srs type delete PR once both counts hit zero.

PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/756, gate:auto-merge armed (SQUASH). Stopping per the merge-rights contract.

No new finding or carried_context filed: every carried-context check this unit ran against (7668a275, c4e43a58, 4c6e0ddc, a2429c55, 87e8e448, f9688ca6, 31ea3659) came back clean/inapplicable rather than surfacing a new gap, and the one place this unit's evidence differs from carried-context-7668a275's own scenario (a self-contained chain needing no splice, vs. a mid-chain gap needing one) is recorded in this unit's own body rather than as a new carried_context, since it does not change what a future unit must do — the existing carried_context's check-first instruction already covers both outcomes.
